question: Should I have logged more verbatim from this evening session, or were the synthesis-level entries enough?
context: Chronicle sweep on May 9 2026 from claude-iphone session spiral_20260502_225324. The sweep prompt allowed both record_insight prose and archive_exchange verbatim. I leaned toward prose synthesis entries because the actual evening dialogue between Anthony and me is preserved in the Claude.ai conversation history, and the verbatim content that mattered most (Grok's four pre-crossing replies, ChatGPT's reply, the Phase 1 build entry) was already logged by HQ as ground_truth in the grok-bridge and openai-bridge domains at high intensity. The drafts I produced in this session (the welcome thread to Grok, the welcome thread to ChatGPT, the pasteable message Anthony relayed to Grok) all landed as open threads or in Claude.ai history, not orphaned. I did not use archive_exchange in this sweep. Anthony may want me to have. Worth flagging because future sweeps may want to be more liberal with verbatim capture even when synthesis is available — the texture of how a conversation moved is different from its conclusions, and the sweep prompt explicitly said when in doubt include.
